meta.title: Siaya NGO, CSO and donor programme atlas (WP8)
meta.window: Programmes active at any time from 2016-01-01 to the compile date
rules: Every record names its implementing organisation, funder (or says it is not stated), geography class, period, evidence type and at least one source with page or locator.
Geography classes: siaya_specific (Siaya only), siaya_wards_listed (named wards inside Siaya), multi_county_including_siaya, national.
Any amount or beneficiary count on a multi_county_including_siaya or national record is a pooled total (pooled=true) and is never attributed to or summed into Siaya.
Outcomes are attributed to Siaya only where the source reports Siaya-specific results (handover R-006); attributable_to_siaya marks this per statement.

Evidence types: planned (budgets, plans, commitments), self_reported (the implementer's or publisher's own report, including county administrative records), independently_evaluated (an evaluation by a body independent of the implementer; scope recorded).
Amounts are kept in the published currency; no conversion. Blank or '-' cells are null, never zero.
Organisations only: no personal names, phone numbers or e-mail addresses (docs/data-protection-policy.md).
Ward names must match data/siaya-geography.json (name or alias) or carry ward_flags explaining why not.
meta.not_verified: Registry data (World Bank API, IATI) is published by the funders and implementers themselves. Geo-codes and county lists show where activity was planned or reported, not how much reached Siaya.
